title: Yoisaki Kanade — A Cup For You〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, I tried changing the feel of the intro a bit. Would you mind listening to it for me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll—

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Welcome, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for having me over again today.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, thank you for coming.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I made some tea but left the cups and teapot out.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
That's okay.
I can wash them and put them away for you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I was wondering what that nice fragrance was. So you made a herbal tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I had some leaves left over from the party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, but Mafuyu was the one who made it today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's the least I could do since you put on the party.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, you don't have to repay me for—

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Also, you still worried me when I was watching you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Really...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I feel like I can do it on my own now after practicing so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, you have gotten better.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Especially compared to when you first tried making tea. You were wandering around with cups and a teapot in your hands.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Let's see... How does Ms. Mochizuki usually prepare tea?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Start by putting a kettle on...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I think she warms up the cups with hot water... That means I have to boil some water first and...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Kanade, why don't you put those cups down for now? You might drop them.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, right.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, when I tried to make tea with Ms. Mochizuki, I ended up putting in too many tea leaves because I wasn't sure what the right amount was. And the tea turned out so strong.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? This looks darker compared to when you make this, Ms. Mochizuki...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait... I can balance that out with a little more water...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
M-Ms. Yoisaki!
Why don't we have some milk tea this time?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Milk goes very well with Earl Grey, so I recommend diluting the tea with that instead of hot water.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I thought the tea we had that time was very good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Thank goodness you suggested that we should have milk tea instead, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I also found a website that mentioned how you should use milk for certain types of tea and hot water for others...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It sounds like you did quite a lot of research in preparation for our tea party...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you again for inviting me to it.
I had a wonderful time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And the tea you made was delicious.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It smelled nice.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad you had such a good time.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That reminds me... I had some of that tea from the party with my family.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My mom enjoyed it so much that she ended up making more for me and herself this morning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really! She even talked about adding in some cinnamon and trying a couple of other variations.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (My initial hope was that everyone would have a somewhat enjoyable time at our party...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But I wasn't expecting it to have such a lasting effect like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And Mafuyu also seemed to enjoy herself.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (So I'm glad we decided to hold that tea party.)
